title: 第5章 谈生意第6章 纳税人
content_zh:
第5章 谈生意
在书房里独自冥想了1个小时之后，老管家约翰前来报告，黄金天平商会仙林城琼斯分会长，已经在客厅等候了。林天收了收心神，稳步走向客厅。
琼斯是一个胖胖的家伙，没想到这个会长居然还是个年轻人，难道是依靠裙带关系上位的，某宅心里恶意的猜测。这胖子看到城主进来，立刻起身相迎。
“恭喜领主大人上位，没想到我们新晋领主居然如此年少有为，真是风流人物啊。此次蒙大人相召，受宠若惊，来时也没什么准备礼物，这枚翡翠美人还算能勉强入眼，还望领主笑纳！”
琼斯说完就递上了礼物，只字不提生意，开来是个滑头。这种类型的商人，哪是我这个纯洁的小宅男能对付得了的啊？某宅怨念丛生，腹黑模式开启。
“会长客气了！请坐！”接过礼物之后，林天决定单刀直入，不能跟这种老油条扯皮，到最后吃亏的肯定是自己。
直接从口袋中拿出一瓶准备好的小红，稳稳的摆在桌上。这个瓶子很精致，把里面红色的纯净**，衬托的有些耀目，一看就知道不是凡品。
“这是？难道是高级的炼金产物，生命药剂？”琼斯大惊，迅速拿起这个小瓶子，进行现场鉴定。某宅暗地里吐嘈了下这死胖子的专业精神。琼斯严肃的集中精神，拿出一把锋利的小刀，在自己的食指上，轻轻地划了道小口子，待流了点血之后，就准备把所谓的生命药剂涂摸在伤口上，林天连忙开口：“喝，喝的！”琼斯略带惊奇的顿了顿，依言小小的喝了一口，伤口马上以肉眼可见的速度全部愈合了，连道疤痕都没有。
“高级货，能恢复为数不少的生命力，而且愈合效果出奇的好！能卖上高价。请问大人您这还有多少货？”
“高级货自然来之不易，能进入拍卖行的也就只有3瓶小红，3瓶小蓝！”说完随即把小瓶蓝色药剂摆了上去。这小胖子果然专业，迅速释放了几个照明术，消耗了一点魔力……看不出这家伙居然还有魔法职业在身啊？不简单！
琼斯集中精神，感知了一下自己的魔力储备之后，小小的喝了一口蓝药，陷入冥想！不过片刻就睁开了眼睛。
“简直是圣药啊，虽然恢复的魔力不算太多，但它好就好在恢复效果快，这要被备上一些这种药，同级法师中绝对无敌，即使越级也能打打。我初步估价这两种高级药剂，市场前景很大，价格差不多都在200金朝上！”
林天嘴角一挑，对能卖到这个价格表示很满意了，这死胖子看来没想坑我。从英雄空间中将+1攻击的剑和+1防御的铠取出来放在桌上。
琼斯眼睛急速的一缩：这种能凭空拿取装备的方法，眼下这个年轻的城主身上，绝对有一件罕有的空间装备，水很深不要轻易惹。
专业的小胖子心思流转，手上却不慢，分别对剑和铠甲进行了鉴定。
“好东西，剑和铠都很坚固耐用，材质上等。最难能可贵的是上面，分别刻画了增强少量攻击和防御的魔法阵，非高级魔法工匠没有这个能力。非常不错。仙林城的佣兵们绝对喜欢，我初步估价每件2000金以上。”
“行，琼斯大人，你把这3瓶小红，3瓶小蓝，剑和铠都拿去拍卖，我看情况决定是否向你们持续供货？”
“oK！交给我吧！我们黄金天平商会最注重信誉，明天这个时候就会给你满意的结果！这是黄金会员卡，请务必收下！”
林天接过黄金会员卡，琼斯解释：一般拍卖行要收5%的手续费，普通会员卡要收4%，而这块黄金会员卡只需要收3%，这也是琼斯能给的最大的权限，后面若想要再提升至白金（2%手续费），水晶（1%手续费），钻石会员卡（不收手续费），就完全要靠交易金额定了。
送走琼斯后，无聊的宅男甲找来老约翰交谈。了解到仙林郡位于人类王国的最东北端，位置相对偏僻多山，周边与兽人，精灵森林，魔兽森林，甚至诅咒之地的亡灵接壤。

魔兽森林存在着大量各级魔兽，有些高级的甚至拥有不俗的智慧。魔兽的肉可以吃，魔兽的血是炼金材料，魔兽皮可以制作魔法皮甲，魔兽的骨头和角可以制作武器和盾牌，魔兽的晶核可以提供魔法能量，全身都是宝。所以离魔兽森林最近的仙林郡，是佣兵的天堂。甚至专门在这个偏僻的城镇开辟了佣兵公会和任务大厅，每天来这里做任务，捕猎，试练的佣兵络绎不绝。
精灵森林很神秘，且被大量精灵控制，很少有人出入，只有捕奴队会冒着生命危险去抓精灵美女（当然精灵美男也是有部分市场的），这种不道德的交易通常会带来巨额利润，但也同样面临着精灵举族的追杀。不过在巨大利益面前，从来不缺不怕死的。人类王国官方是禁止捕奴的，但从来无法根治，所以与精灵的关系并不太好。
诅咒之地的亡灵几十年前，经过了光明教会组织的大规模圣战，元气已经大伤，高级亡灵大多退到了更深的地方，外层只有少量低级骷髅僵尸游弋，是试炼做任务的好地方。不过诅咒之地长年累月漂浮的怨气无法被净化，人类是无法长期生存的，不然人族领地还能有一个大的扩展。
兽人族无论个体实力和综合实力，都要比人族强，且好斗成性，其中有天生的皇族比蒙一族，四大上级贵族分别是纯血兽族、狮族、虎族、鹰族，四大中级贵族分别是豹族、狼族、牛头人族、熊人族，还有其他很多种族如猪头人，狗头人，半人马，半兽人，娜迦族等等。各族战士数量和实力不尽相同。有消息说这一代新晋比蒙王很年轻好斗，准备近期集结部队，向占据大片富饶土地的人族开战。
哎呀，异界生存也不易啊！

Chapter 5 Talking about business
After meditating alone in the study for an hour, the old butler John came to report that the president of the Xianlin City Jones branch of the Golden Scale Chamber of Commerce was already waiting in the living room. Lin Tian calmed down and walked steadily towards the living room.
Jones is a fat guy. Unexpectedly, the president is still a young man. Could it be that he relied on nepotism to get to the position? A certain person made a malicious guess in his heart. When the fat man saw the city lord coming in, he immediately stood up to greet him.
"Congratulations, Lord, on taking the throne. I didn't expect that our new Lord would be so young and promising. He is such a cool person. I was flattered by Lord Meng's call this time. I didn't prepare any gifts when I came. This emerald beauty can barely catch my eye. I hope the Lord will accept it!"
After finishing speaking, Jones handed over the gift without saying a word about business, which seemed to be a slippery thing. How can a pure otaku like me deal with this type of businessman? There is a lot of resentment in a certain house, and the sinister mode is on.
"President, you're welcome! Please sit down!" After receiving the gift, Lin Tian decided to go straight to the point. He couldn't argue with such an old man. He would definitely be the one to suffer in the end.
He took out a prepared bottle of red directly from his pocket and placed it firmly on the table. This bottle is very delicate. The pure red color inside makes it look dazzling. You can tell at a glance that it is not ordinary.
"Is this? Is it an advanced alchemy product, a life potion?" Jones was shocked and quickly picked up the small bottle for on-site identification. A certain house secretly complained about this fat guy's professionalism. Jones concentrated seriously, took out a sharp knife, and lightly made a small cut on his index finger. After some blood flowed, he was ready to apply the so-called life potion on the wound. Lin Tian quickly said: "Drink, drink!" Jones paused in surprise, and took a small sip. The wound immediately healed at a speed visible to the naked eye, without even a scar.
"High-end goods can restore a lot of vitality, and the healing effect is surprisingly good! They can be sold at high prices. Sir, how many goods do you have left?"
"High-end goods are naturally hard-won. There are only 3 bottles of small red and 3 bottles of small blue that can enter the auction house!" After saying that, he immediately placed the small bottle of blue potion on the table. This little fat guy is indeed professional. He quickly released a few lighting spells and consumed a little magic power... Can't you see that this guy actually has a magic profession? not simple!
Jones concentrated on feeling his own magic power reserve, then took a small sip of the blue medicine and fell into meditation! After a moment, he opened his eyes.
"It is simply a holy medicine. Although the magic power restored is not too much, the good thing about it is that it has a fast recovery effect. You need to prepare some of this medicine. It is absolutely invincible among mages of the same level. Even if you skip a level, you can still fight. I initially estimate that these two high-level medicines have a great market prospect, and the prices are almost 200 gold upwards!"
Lin Tian raised the corner of his mouth and expressed that he was very satisfied with the price. This damn fat man didn't seem to want to trick me. Take out the +1 attack sword and +1 defense armor from the hero space and place them on the table.
Jones's eyes narrowed rapidly: This way of taking equipment out of thin air, this young city lord definitely has a rare space equipment on his body. The water is very deep, so don't mess with it easily.
The professional fat man's mind was busy, but his hands were not slow. He appraised the sword and armor respectively.
"Good stuff. The sword and armor are both durable and made of high-quality materials. The most valuable thing is that there are magic circles on them that enhance a small amount of attack and defense. Non-senior magic craftsmen don't have this ability. It's very good. The mercenaries in Xianlin City absolutely love it. I initially estimate it to be more than 2,000 gold per piece."
"Okay, Lord Jones, you put these 3 bottles of little red, 3 bottles of little blue, swords and armors at auction. I will decide whether to continue supplying to you based on the situation."
"oK! Leave it to me! Our golden skyPing Chamber of Commerce attaches great importance to credibility and will give you satisfactory results at this time tomorrow! This is a gold membership card, please be sure to accept it! "
Lin Tian took the gold membership card, and Jones explained: Generally, auction houses charge a 5% handling fee, and ordinary membership cards charge 4%, but this gold membership card only charges 3%, which is the greatest authority Jones can give. If you want to upgrade to platinum (2% handling fee), crystal (1% handling fee), or diamond membership card (no handling fee), it all depends on the transaction amount.
After sending Jones away, bored homeboy A came to talk to Old John. I learned that Xianlin County is located at the northeastern end of the human kingdom. It is relatively remote and mountainous, and is bordered by orcs, elven forests, monster forests, and even the undead in the Cursed Land.
There are a large number of monsters of all levels in the Warcraft Forest, and some advanced ones even possess considerable wisdom. The meat of Warcraft can be eaten, the blood of Warcraft is an alchemical material, the skin of Warcraft can be used to make magic leather armor, the bones and horns of Warcraft can be used to make weapons and shields, and the crystal core of Warcraft can provide magic energy. The whole body is full of treasures. Therefore, Xianlin County, which is closest to the World of Warcraft Forest, is a paradise for mercenaries. There is even a mercenary guild and mission hall specially opened in this remote town. There is an endless stream of mercenaries who come here every day to do missions, hunt, and test.
The Elf Forest is very mysterious and is controlled by a large number of elves. Very few people come in and out. Only the slave-catching team will risk their lives to capture the beautiful elves (of course there is also a certain market for beautiful elven men). This kind of unethical transaction usually brings huge profits, but it also faces the pursuit of the entire elven clan. However, in the face of huge interests, there is never a shortage of people who are not afraid of death. The human kingdom officially prohibits slave hunting, but it has never been cured, so the relationship with the elves is not very good.
Decades ago, the undead in the Cursed Land experienced a large-scale jihad organized by the Church of Light, and their vitality was severely damaged. Most of the high-level undead retreated deeper into the area. Only a small number of low-level skeleton zombies roamed in the outer layer, making it a good place for trials and tasks. However, the grievances that have been floating in the cursed land for many years cannot be purified, and humans cannot survive for a long time, otherwise the human race's territory will be greatly expanded.
The orcs are stronger than the humans in terms of individual strength and overall strength, and are aggressive by nature. Among them are the Behemoth clan, a natural royal family. The four upper-level nobles are pure-blooded orcs, lions, tigers, and eagles. The four intermediate nobles are leopards, wolves, tauren, and bears. There are also many other races such as pig-headed people, dog-headed people, centaurs, half-orcs, Nagas, and so on. The number and strength of warriors from each race vary. There is news that this generation of new King Behemoth is very young and aggressive, and is preparing to gather troops in the near future to start a war against the human race who occupy a large area of rich land.
Oops, it’s not easy to survive in another world!
